Title: When are the functional changes made by BCP Effective?

Messages.Author: William_Feitosa
Messages.Body:
Greetings fellow Mathuselah,

Just today Black Chantry made a post on their website updating the list of cards for print on demand and some funcional changes to some cards.

Here is the link to that post: www.blackchantry.com/2021/09/23/119-cards-added-to-vampire-the-eternal-struggle-legacy-singles/

My question is, when are these changes effective? The post doesnt state as of this moment (some edit may be done in the near future) when the funcional changes will be implemented for competitive play, hence my question.

Thank you for your time,

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Changes will be effective 30 days after the release, that is on Octobre 23rd 2021.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
